summary: Phase 4 (SHADOW MODE) frontend and integration test of /advanced-access-control. Run on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844) as admin, Saeed, Salim and a temporary tester (teacher180156). Teachers are blocked from web login by an existing legacy rule, so the teacher was logged in by injecting a token into localStorage. WORKING: all 11 tabs render for admin. Role creation works: picking 1 single permission plus select-all on the attendance group (34) saved as 35. Editing works: removing 1 gave 34, adding 2 gave 36, and the saves persisted. Two assignments for Saeed: A1 is academic on faculty كلية البنات with 36 permissions, A2 is administrative on unit رئاسة الجامعة with the imported teacher role and 20 permissions. Both appear in the list. AdvContextPage and the global switcher show different permission sets per context; the only overlap is 1 permission, which comes from how the roles were built, not a leak. The global switcher appears and works on /, /students and /manage-roles. The legacy side menu text is identical before and after switching context. Ending A2 leaves A1 active, and A1 still shows 36 permissions. Simulator results make sense: in-scope allowed, out-of-scope denied with a scope reason, a permission removed from the role denied, and the teacher-role permission allowed / not allowed as expected. Compare gives A1 36 effective / 3 comparable, all allowed by both systems; A2 20/20 allowed by both. Phase-3 security fixes confirmed through the UI: admin logs in, logs out, then Salim logs in with no reload, and the switcher is gone at once with no adv menu item. Saeed editing an imported role shows 'تعديل الأدوار المستوردة من النظام القديم للأدمن فقط'. Saeed assigning a role to himself shows 'لا يمكنك إسناد تكليف لنفسك'. A view-only tester sees the 'تحتاج صلاحية' message on the simulator, compare and audit tabs, gets no management buttons, gets 403 from the backend right after revoke, and sees the denied screen after a reload. Legacy pages (/manage-users, /manage-roles, /permissions, /students) for admin, Salim and Saeed contain no adv-* elements and no SHADOW text, and git shows no legacy files changed. NEW BUGS: the testers tab sends any non-admin tester to /no-permission, the dashboard shows all zeros for non-admin testers, there are unhandled promise rejections, and the floating buttons overlap the page header.

minor.issue: Escalation risk remains (shadow-only, so no real-system effect): a non-admin tester with manage_assignments (Saeed) can assign '[مستورد] مدير النظام' with university scope to ANOTHER user and gets 200. Verified; the probe assignment was ended in teardown. Only self-assignment is blocked. manage_roles also lets him create a brand-new (non-imported) role containing all 976 permissions.
This works as designed, but note it: anyone holding run_tests (Saeed) can read every user's context and effective_permissions (200). A tester with only context_switch correctly gets 403 (verified).
Only needs 'view'. A view-only tester can list all 77 assignments of all users (names, roles, scopes).

ui_bugs.issue: For any non-admin tester (Saeed, or the view-only teacher), load() calls GET /testers, which is admin-only and returns 403. The global axios 403 interceptor then redirects to /no-permission?reason=للأدمن فقط, so the user is thrown out of the whole center. Reproduced on desktop and mobile. Fix: call getTesters only when isAdmin; otherwise show just the 'admin only' note, or add a /me tester endpoint.

For non-admin testers every stat shows 0 (0 groups, 0 permissions, 0 roles, 0/0 assignments). Cause: Promise.all includes getTesters() (admin-only) and getAuditLogs(1) (needs view_audit), so one 403 rejects the whole batch and the catch swallows it. Fix: use Promise.allSettled and skip the admin-only calls. Also, the 'إعادة فحص الكود (للأدمن)' button is shown to non-admins.

ui_bugs.component: AdvRolesManager / AdvAssignmentsManager load(), promote(), endAssignment(), viewContext(); AdvTestersManager revoke()
ui_bugs.issue: These calls have no .catch. After access is revoked (or on any 403/500), clicking the roles tab produced 'Uncaught Error: Request failed with status code 403' (red overlay in the dev build). Add try/catch and show an error state.

Because headerShown:false, the floating menu, search and global-switcher buttons sit on top of the custom blue header. The title is cut off ('د…الصلاحيات المتقدم') and the back arrow is partly hidden, on both desktop and mobile. Add right padding (~130px) to the header or offset the floating row.

The permission search only matches label_ar (searching by key returns nothing). Labels repeat heavily (e.g. 'إضافة — api' 48 times, 'إضافة — students' 8 times), and the simulator list does not show key or linked_api, so the options cannot be told apart. The simulator also loads users through getLightUsers (needs manage_assignments), so a tester with run_tests but without manage_assignments would hit a 403 and be redirected (code review, not executed).

integration_issues.issue: activeContext lives only in memory (zustand), so it is lost on any full page reload. It is also not cleared when its assignment is ended, so a stale context can remain until the next switch.

issues: Horizontal chip rows (users, roles, scope types) are laid out left-to-right: they start at the left edge and overflow off-screen on the right, which is wrong for RTL
123 users shown as one horizontal chip row with no search; very hard to use
Search placeholders sit on the left with the ellipsis on the wrong side ('...بحث سريع عن صلاحية'); mixed Latin/Arabic input values (e.g. 'TEST_P4 عميد…') render left-aligned

structural_only: The 11 tabs render and all testIDs resolve as data-testid on web
Role permission counts match picker selections (35 → 34 → 36)
Assignment cards show role, type and scope labels
The global switcher appears on /, /students and /manage-roles for admin and Saeed
behavioral_security_verified: Salim: denied screen, no switcher, no menu item, and 403 on /roles, /assignments, /permissions and /me/contexts
Admin → logout → Salim with no reload: switcher disappears immediately (state-leak fix confirmed)
Saeed self-assignment rejected in the UI with the backend message
Saeed editing an imported role rejected in the UI with the backend message
View-only tester: 403 on any API call right after revoke, and denied screen on reload
context_switch-only tester gets 403 reading another user's context (IDOR fix)
Simulator gives a scope-based denial outside the assigned faculty
Legacy side menu unchanged by context switching; legacy pages show no adv elements

action_items: AdvTestersManager: do not call GET /testers when !isAdmin (it currently sends non-admin testers to /no-permission)
AdvDashboard: use Promise.allSettled and skip admin-only/view_audit calls for non-admins; hide the rescan button for non-admins
Add catch/error states to every advancedAccessAPI call in the managers (load/promote/end/viewContext/revoke)
Fix the header overlap on /advanced-access-control (floating buttons cover the title and back arrow)
Simulator: search by key/linked_api too and show linked_api under each option; don't depend on manage_assignments for the users list
Optional hardening: block non-admin testers from assigning imported/admin-level roles to other users
Fix RTL order of the horizontal chip pickers and add a user search in the assignment modal
critical_code_review_comments: Several components assume admin-level sub-permissions when loading data. The UI's sub-permission gating and the backend's per-endpoint requirements are out of sync: dashboard → testers/audit, simulator → users(manage_assignments), testers tab → testers(admin).
The global 403 interceptor turns any secondary 403 inside the center into a full-page redirect, so every optional call needs explicit gating.
activeContext should be invalidated when its assignment is ended and re-validated on load.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all 9 requested flows run; 2 HIGH bugs on non-admin tester tabs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_150: Phase-3 fixes were confirmed in the UI. Open bugs: the testers tab redirects non-admins to /no-permission; the dashboard shows zeros for non-admins; missing catches in the managers; header overlap. Retest with Saeed: dashboard counts should be non-zero, and the testers tab should show the admin-only note without a redirect. Login inputs have no testIDs; use placeholders 'اسم المستخدم…' and 'كلمة المرور'. Modals slide in, so use dispatch_event('click') or wait ~1.5s.
rca of the issue: Testers-tab redirect: AdvTestersManager.load() always calls advancedAccessAPI.getTesters(). Backend list_testers raises 403 for non-admins. The api.ts response interceptor redirects to /no-permission on a 403 GET. Dashboard zeros: Promise.all([... getTesters(), getAuditLogs(1)]) rejects on the first 403 and the catch leaves every count at its initial 0.
